harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured a PAM limits.d file capping its login sessions at 8,192 open files (nofile) and 256 processes (nproc), soft and hard. Verified the limits apply in an actual login shell before and after a full node restart, and confirmed the node's boot ID changed to prove a real reboot occurred.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (CentOS Stream 10) and confirmed appworker did not yet exist
Captured baseline boot_id and system health before making changes
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf setting soft/hard nofile 8192 and soft/hard nproc 256 for appworker
Verified limits took effect via 'su -l appworker -c ulimit -n / ulimit -u' (8192 / 256)
Scheduled and executed a native systemctl reboot on node1 with acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until it became reachable again
Confirmed boot_id changed from 83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a to 1ad6ab41-56b3-493c-a61d-e8c345b5e298, proving a real restart
Post-restart, re-verified appworker account, limits.d config file, and live ulimit values in a fresh login session

evidence.summary: Confirmed appworker did not exist, then created it with useradd -m; id shows uid=1000(appworker)

evidence.requirement: Limit appworker login sessions to 8192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf with nofile/nproc 8192/256, then confirmed via su -l appworker that ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256
Captured boot_id 83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a and systemctl is-system-running=running prior to restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded systemctl reboot (ack returned), observed connection timeout during the reboot window, then reconnected with new boot_id 1ad6ab41-56b3-493c-a61d-e8c345b5e298 proving the restart occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 recovered state after restart (account and limits persisted)
evidence.summary: Post-restart: appworker account still present, limits.d file intact, and live ulimit -n/-u in a new login session show 8192/256
